def: probably akin to G3534 (νῖκος)); fond of strife, i.e. disputatious

occurrences.text: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
